firstPlayerRule: The player who was most recently in the mountains takes the starting player marker.
clarifications: The first two phases of each turn are simultaneous. In the Action phase, the marker holder acts first, then play proceeds clockwise.
At the end of each turn, the marker passes to the player on the left.
